run.procedureSummary: Step 1, Feed: add each chamber's feed from the table for that cycle. No trimming. Step 2, Carry forward: go through chambers 1 to 6 in order. Any amount above a chamber's limit moves into the next chamber, and that chamber is checked after it has received the excess, so excess can cascade. Chamber 6's excess goes to loss. Step 3, State check on post-carry mass: a LARVAL chamber at or above its upper mark becomes PUPAL. A PUPAL chamber at or below its lower mark becomes LARVAL. Between the marks the state holds. Each chamber changes at most once per cycle. Step 4, Metabolism: first work out all six amounts from the post-carry contents (LARVAL floor(m/4), PUPAL floor(m/2)), then subtract them all at once. LARVAL amounts go to loss. PUPAL amounts are added to chamber i-1, except chamber 1's, which goes to loss. No limit is applied. Step 5, Moult: if the six-chamber total is strictly above 38, every chamber keeps floor(m/2) and the remainder goes to loss. At 38 or below, nothing happens.

openPoints.point: What metabolism uses for its amounts and states
openPoints.assumption: Amounts are based on post-carry contents and on the states after this cycle's step 3, all worked out before any transfer is applied.
It goes into chamber i-1 and stays in the line, so it is not counted as loss. Chamber 1's PUPAL amount is discarded and goes to loss.
The moult fires only when the total is strictly above 38. Each chamber keeps floor(m/2) and the odd unit is discarded to loss. The check uses the total after metabolism.

openPoints.point: Over-limit chambers after metabolism, and the end figures
openPoints.assumption: Chambers may sit over their limit after metabolism and reabsorption (for example chamber 2 ends at 10, limit 8, and chamber 4 ends at 7, limit 6). These are left as they are at the end of cycle 5.

openPoints.point: Order of the state change and the carry when cascading
openPoints.assumption: The carry finishes for all six chambers before any state check, and a cascade reaching chamber k counts toward chamber k's own limit check.

run.balanceCheck: Starting quantities 20 + all feed 94 = 114 = end quantities 38 (6+10+9+7+4+2) + loss tally 76. The balance holds.
